subtitle: Welcome to AstrBot. See how things are running today and continue your setup.

onboard.title: Quick Onboarding
onboard.subtitle: Complete the basics and start using AstrBot.
onboard.step2Desc: Connect AstrBot to IM platforms like QQ, Lark, Slack, Telegram, etc.
onboard.step3Title: Allow Agent to Use the Computer
onboard.step3Desc: Set whether the Agent can access and use this computer.
onboard.step3HelpItem1: The Agent can access and use the workspace directory, which is isolated for each user, as well as Skills to handle more complex tasks.
onboard.step3HelpItem2: For AstrBot administrators, the Agent is additionally allowed to execute shell commands, run Python code, and access all local directories on this machine.
onboard.providerUpdateFailed: Failed to update default chat provider in config file "default"
onboard.providerDefaultUpdated: Default chat provider in config file "default" has been set to {id}
onboard.computerAccessUpdateFailed: Failed to update Agent computer access
onboard.computerAccessAllowed: Agent is now allowed to access and use the computer
onboard.computerAccessDenied: Agent is no longer allowed to access and use the computer
onboard.step3HelpItem3: For more detailed control, configure the Computer Access options under Config -> AI -> Capabilities -> Agent Computer Use.

system.title: System status
system.scope: Uptime measures the AstrBot process. CPU and memory show host usage; disk shows the filesystem containing the AstrBot data directory.
system.unavailable: Resource usage is unavailable. Refresh the page to try again.

guide.title: Getting Started
guide.trialHint: Click a starter prompt below or send any message in the input box to test live responses from your model.
guide.welcomeHint: You have completed the setup guide.
guide.testFailed: Model connection test failed. Check your settings and try again.
guide.adapterSkipHint: You can still use ChatUI without setting up an adapter.
guide.agentGreeting: Hello, welcome to AstrBot. I will guide you through initial setup right in this conversation—please review the usage notice to begin.
guide.agentAskModel: Next, configure an AI model. Once saved, you can chat with me directly in this conversation to verify the connection.
guide.agentModelReady: Model {model} is ready. Send a message below to test responses, or continue to connect a messaging platform.
guide.agentModelUpdated: Model updated to {model}. You can keep chatting below to test it.
guide.agentAskPlatform: You can connect AstrBot to messaging platforms such as QQ, Lark, or Telegram. If you only want Web ChatUI for now, feel free to skip.
guide.agentAskPlatformAfterModelSkip: Model setup skipped (model trial unlocks once a model is configured—you can click Configure above anytime). Next, you can connect a messaging platform such as QQ, Lark, or Telegram, or skip for now to use Web ChatUI.
guide.agentAllDone: Initial setup is complete! Select a button below to start using AstrBot.
guide.agentHintNotice: Please confirm the usage notice in the card above, or choose Skip setup.
guide.agentHintModel: No AI model is configured yet. Choose a provider and save a model in the card above, or skip this step.
guide.agentChatFailed: Failed to send the message. Please check your model settings or network connection and try again.
guide.userConfirmedNotice: I have reviewed the usage notice. Let's continue.
guide.userOpenPlatform: Continue to connect a messaging platform.
guide.userSkippedPlatform: Skip platform setup for now and use ChatUI.
guide.userReopenModel: I want to update the AI model configuration.
guide.userReopenPlatform: I want to update the messaging platform configuration.
guide.starterTest: Send a short Markdown test reply
guide.placeholderSetup: Type "continue" or "skip", or complete the card above...
guide.placeholderChat: Send a message to test the model, or type "next" to continue...
guide.placeholderDone: Keep chatting below, or click Get started...
